arxiv-2010-01605.title: Energy dependence of light neutral meson p T p_{\rm T} spectrum produced in pp collisions at the LHC measured in ALICE
arxiv-2010-01605.creator: for the ALICE collaboration
arxiv-2010-01605.description: Abstract We present the measurement of light neutral mesons, π 0 \pi^{0} and η \eta , in pp collisions at different center-of-mass energies obtained with the ALICE experiment at the LHC. The π 0 \pi^{0} and η \eta mesons are measured via photons reconstructed by the electromagnetic calorimeters and the central tracking system.

arxiv-2212-00923.title: A Tractable Probability Distribution with Applications in Three-Dimensional Statistics
arxiv-2212-00923.creator: Seyed Mohammad Azimi-Abarghouyi
arxiv-2212-00923.description: Abstract This paper introduces and characterizes a new family of continuous probability distributions applicable to norm distributions in three-dimensional random spaces, specifically for the Euclidean norm of three random Gaussian variables with non-zero means. The distribution is specified over the semi-infinite range [ 0 , ∞ ) [0,\infty) and is notable for its computational tractability.

arxiv-2302-11189.title: Topological classes of BTZ black holes
arxiv-2302-11189.creator: Yongbin Du, Xiangdong Zhang
arxiv-2302-11189.description: Abstract In the recent paper [Phys. Rev. Lett. 129, 191101 (2022)], the black holes were viewed as topological thermodynamic defects by using the generalized off-shell free energy. Their work indicates that all black hole solutions in the pure Einstein-Maxwell gravity theory could be classified into three different topological classes for four and higher spacetime dimensions.

arxiv-2312-02803.title: Leveraging Domain Adaptation and Data Augmentation to Improve Qur’anic IR in English and Arabic
arxiv-2312-02803.creator: Vera Pavlova
arxiv-2312-02803.description: Abstract In this work, we approach the problem of Qur’anic information retrieval (IR) in Arabic and English. Using the latest state-of-the-art methods in neural IR, we research what helps to tackle this task more efficiently. Training retrieval models requires a lot of data, which is difficult to obtain for training in-domain.

arxiv-2401-17756.title: Electromagnetic form factors of the transition from the Delta to the nucleon
arxiv-2401-17756.creator: Moh Moh Aung, Stefan Leupold, Elisabetta Perotti, Yupeng Yan
arxiv-2401-17756.description: Abstract The low-energy electromagnetic form factors of the Δ \Delta (1232)-to-nucleon transition are derived combining dispersion theory techniques and chiral perturbation theory. The form factors are expressed in terms of the well-understood pion vector form factor and pion-baryon scattering amplitudes. Nucleon and Delta exchange terms and contact terms constitute the input for these pion-baryon amplitudes.

arxiv-2409-19857.title: Derived Category of certain maximal order on ℙ 2 \mathbb{P}^{2}
arxiv-2409-19857.creator: Yu Shen
arxiv-2409-19857.description: Abstract . We show that the moduli space of A A -line bundles with minimal second Chern class is a fine moduli space, where A A is a maximal quaternion order on ℙ 2 \mathbb{P}^{2} ramified along a smooth quartic.

arxiv-2510-04746.description: Abstract Massive stars exhibit a perplexing mismatch between their inferred masses from different observational techniques, posing a significant challenge to our understanding of stellar evolution and structure. This discrepancy is believed to be caused by the underestimation of the convective core masses.

arxiv-2512-08252.title: Causal inference under interference: computational barriers and algorithmic solutions
arxiv-2512-08252.creator: Sohom Bhattacharya, Subhabrata Sen
arxiv-2512-08252.description: Abstract We study causal effect estimation under interference from network data. We work under the chain-graph formulation pioneered in [ 101 ] . Our first result shows that polynomial time evaluation of treatment effects is computationally hard in this framework without additional assumptions on the underlying chain graph.

pmc-11680387.description: Di(2-ethhylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) is a common plastic rubberizer. DEHP leaches from plastic matrices and is under increasing scrutiny as numerous studies have linked it to negative human health manifestations. Coxsackievirus B3 (CVB) is a human pathogen that typically causes subclinical infections but can sometimes cause severe diseases such as pancreatitis, myocarditis, and meningoencephalitis.

pmc-12587708.creator: Patricia Ghattas Hasbun, Ernesto Calderon Martinez, Joanne Arvelaez Pascucci, Jaqueline Livier Castillo, Angie Alonso-Ramírez, Maria Marcela Giron De Marza, Jonathan Martinez Illan, Briggitte Sosaya Zuñiga, Karen Camacho Davila, Gabriela Flores Monar, Camila Sanchez Cruz

pmc-13606839.title: Active Packaging, Fruit Volatilome, and the Preservation of Taste and Aroma Quality in Fresh Fruits: A Review
pmc-13606839.creator: Pedro Melgarejo-Martínez, Antonio López-Gómez, José Ramón Acosta-Motos, Ginés Benito Martínez-Hernández, Juan D. Franco-Navarro, Antonio José Pérez-López

Associations with clinicopathological parameters and overall survival were analysed.
